split.policy: Chronological 70/10/20 split; early stopping uses development only; holdout untouched.

identity_audit.policy: No permanent NAR horse ID is present in the published monthly runner CSV; complete composite identities are used where possible and incomplete identities are isolated per race to prevent cross-horse history contamination.

market_comparison.odds_source: NAR official monthly confirmed final win odds; retrospective only, not pre-off odds

fixed_stake_methods.win: 100 yen on each strategy's top-ranked runner
fixed_stake_methods.trio_2_4_5_narrow12: 2-4-5 formation narrowed to 12 combinations; equal allocation totaling 1,900 yen per race

betting_returns.caveat: Retrospective ranking and official payout simulation; market favorite uses final odds, not executable pre-off odds. No slippage or operational constraints modeled.

ticket_policy.wide_top3: All three unordered pairs among top 3, 100 JPY each
ticket_policy.quinella_top2: Top two as unordered pair, 100 JPY
ticket_policy.exacta_top2: Top two in predicted order, 100 JPY
ticket_policy.trio_top3: Top three as unordered trio, 100 JPY
ticket_policy.trifecta_top3_box: All six permutations of top three, 100 JPY each

multi_bet_type_returns.caveat: Fixed ticket simulation from retrospective rankings and official payouts; does not imply executable pre-off prices or profitability.

market_comparison.policy: Every listed model and final-odds favorite is evaluated on exactly the same holdout races and the same matched runner subset. Market odds are used only as a retrospective benchmark, never as model input or a live betting price.

wide_top3_optimization.selection_policy: Select on the second chronological half of development only, after early stopping on the first half. Primary score is geometric mean of wide ROI% and race hit-rate%; tie-break by ROI then hit rate.

development_metrics.policy: Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).
Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).
Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).
Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).

selected_development_metrics.policy: Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).

holdout_baseline_metrics.policy: Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).

holdout_selected_metrics.policy: Top 3 ranked runners; all 3 wide pairs; 100 JPY per pair (300 JPY per race).

wide_top3_optimization.holdout_policy: Untouched chronological holdout; used only once for final evaluation, never for candidate selection.

walk_forward_validation.policy: Three expanding chronological folds; training and development always precede each untouched test block. Test blocks do not overlap.

plackett_luce_fit.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

limitations: Research-only ranking; no production model or ticket logic changed.
LAB_feature_enhanced includes LAB score components; independent_raw excludes all LAB-derived scores.
LambdaRank and Plackett-Luce use independent_raw features only.
Top1/Top3 are ranking metrics, not profitability or betting-return evidence.
Market benchmark uses official confirmed final odds retrospectively, not odds available before the race.
Official monthly NAR odds archives are restricted to 2026-03 onward; earlier holdout dates are excluded from the market comparison.

Venue, distance, field-size and going segments are descriptive diagnostics on the same odds-matched races, not evidence of profitability.NAR monthly CSV has no permanent horse ID; history uses a conservative composite of birth date, sex, sire, dam and name, isolating incomplete identities per race.
Feature importance is model-native gain/importance, not causal attribution.
All same-day race results are withheld until that date's feature generation is complete.
All category mappings and PL scaling are fit on training data only; early stopping uses development only.
